title: Osinga, Frans P.B. — Science, Strategy and War: The Strategic Theory of John Boyd (2007)
citation: Osinga, Frans P.B. (2007). Science, Strategy and War: The Strategic Theory of John Boyd. Abingdon: Routledge (Strategy and History series). Originated as a 2005 PhD dissertation, Leiden University.
notes: Widely cited academic analysis of Boyd's complete body of briefings, situating the OODA loop within Boyd's broader theory of conflict. Identified via web search; only a preview/summary was reviewed for this execution, not the full monograph, so claims attributed to this source are limited to what is corroborated by search-result summaries.
